title: Remember a changing value
summary: A ref is a small container for a value that Vue can watch.
introduction: A ref is a small container for a value that Vue can watch. Your task: Start the counter at 5 instead of 0.
learningObjectives: Start the counter at 5 instead of 0.
Explain the example for remember a changing value

blocks.text: A ref is a small container for a value that Vue can watch. Templates unwrap its value for you.
Use a Vue 3 project made with the official create-vue tool. Put single-file examples in App.vue unless file names say otherwise. These need the Vue build tool and do not run in the plain playground.

blocks.code:
<script setup>
import { ref } from "vue";
const count = ref(0);
</script>
<template><button @click="count++">Books: {{ count }}</button></template>
blocks.title: Remember a changing value

blocks.text: Read the code step by step

items: `ref` wraps a reactive Vue value. Script code uses `.value`; the template unwraps it for you.

blocks.text: Each click increases the displayed count by one.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: In script code, use count.value to read or change the ref value. Templates can use count directly.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Start the counter at 5 instead of 0.
